Description: Atomic Machines is fabricating micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS), which are microscopic machines used for a wide variety of applications, like sensors, switches/relays, optics and so on. As examples, the modern mobile phone has several MEMS devices, e.g. accelerometer, gyroscope, autofocus and haptic feedback.
